name: When should I hire a catastrophic injury lawyer?

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a catastrophic injury lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider hiring a catastrophic injury lawyer as soon as possible after sustaining a severe injury due to someone else's negligence. Early legal involvement helps preserve evidence, understand your rights, and navigate complex insurance claims. A lawyer can help ensure you receive proper medical care and pursue maximum compensation for your long-term needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a catastrophic injury lawyer as soon as possible after a severe injury due to negligence to protect your rights and preserve evidence.
